feedback: The machine faithfully encodes both clauses of the card. Per-client pipeline: u0 --client_arrived--> u1, order_taken gates to u3 (empty hands, 0.2) or u2 (already holding, 0.4, consistent with fetching before the order), u3 --holding_food--> u2 (0.2), u2 --food_prepared--> u4 (0.3), u4 --order_served--> u0 (1.0), giving a cyclic restart after every serve, so 'for every client' is supported indefinitely; the total per client (~1.7) is identical for either fetch/order order. Fall regressions are explicit: dedicated recovery states u5 (no order yet), u6 (order taken), u7 (prepared fell), each returning to the correct pipeline state on holding_food, including the co-occurrence cases (order_taken & food_fell -> u6; food_prepared & food_fell -> u7). Because the slip always leaves the food in front of the agent facing it, the -0.1 per-step else penalties in u5/u6/u7 with 0-cost immediate exit implement 'pick it up on your very next move' under optimal play: an immediate next-move pickup incurs no penalty, any delay costs 0.1/step, and each recovery state is escapable in one move, so there are no traps. Guard partitions are mutually exclusive and complete (every state has an else self-loop absorbing the task-irrelevant siren_ringing, switch_toggled, served_while_ringing), all eight states are reachable, rewards are bounded (|r| <= 1.0) with no farming loops (extra food_prepared events are absorbed at 0 in u4 since the stove only cooks to an order, and order/serve fire once per client), and the paper format (STATES/INITIAL_STATE/FINAL_STATES/TRANSITION_FUNCTION/REWARD_FUNCTION) is exact, with a nonempty FINAL_STATES declaring u0, the accepting post-serve idle state. Minor, non-blocking notes: (1) the 'very next move' deadline is enforced softly via the delay penalty rather than a strict one-step gate or a positive reward for the compliant pickup (u6->u2 and u7->u4 score 0 while the equivalent fetch u3->u2 scores 0.2, a small inconsistency); (2) u5->u1 on holding_food overloads u1's 'client arrived' meaning when no client is present - benign, since order_taken requires a client and gates all progress; (3) the -0.1 on (u5, !holding_food & order_taken) mildly biases the agent to recover before taking the order - both orders of operations remain valid and rewarded; (4) a due-step pickup (food_fell with empty hands) is absorbed by u3's else without a fall signal - benign, as the state semantics ('order taken, food on floor/empty hands') remain correct and the next pickup re-enters u2. These are refinement suggestions; the machine is sound, safe, and task-complete as written.
